name: Northeastern University
feeMethod: Charges one undergraduate tuition for every major, so every major costs the same.
description: Northeastern University is a private research university in Boston, Massachusetts, founded in 1898. It is known for its cooperative education (co-op) programme, in which students alternate study with full-time work placements.
whyIncluded: Northeastern reports over 250 registered alumni in the region and is building co-op placements in Singapore with employers including NUS and NTU.

livingCosts.summary: Northeastern's official 2026-27 cost of attendance for Boston: housing, food, transportation, and personal expenses plus books, spread over a 9-month academic year. Housing and food vary with the housing and dining plan chosen.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A. Northeastern Admissions 'Cost & Financial Aid', 'Estimated Cost of Attendance, 2026-2027' for Boston first-year students (subject to Board of Trustees approval): tuition 71,050, fees 1,650, housing 13,612, food 9,210, books and course materials 1,000, personal expenses 900, transportation 900, total 98,322. The page gives annual academic-year figures and does not state months or separate on-/off-campus allowances; 9 months recorded per the standard US academic-year convention. housing = 13,612 / 9 = 1,512.44; food = 9,210 / 9 = 1,023.33; transport = 900 / 9 = 100; personal = (900 personal + 1,000 books) / 9 = 211.11. Tuition and fees excluded; the page does not list health insurance (NUSHP) in the COA.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering, BSME (Boston)
programmes.feeBasis: Northeastern's single 2026-27 Boston undergraduate tuition (US$35,525 per term, two terms), the same for every major, plus the comprehensive fee.
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international undergraduates at Northeastern, same for all majors, plus the comprehensive fee. Rises most years; health insurance and housing fees not included.
programmes.notes: Student Financial Services tuition and fees page, Boston undergraduate: full-time tuition $35,525 per term x2 = $71,050 (2026-27); $33,995 x2 = $67,990 (2025-26, same page). Other fees 2026-27 = Comprehensive Fee $788 per semester (maximum $1,576 a year), which replaced the 2025-26 student activity ($180/yr), student center ($85/sem), recreation ($75/sem) and undergraduate student ($362.50/sem) fees = $1,225; 2025-26 also had a one-time International Student Fee $450, which the 2026-27 undergraduate table no longer lists. Residential Student Fee ($37/sem, campus residents only), course lab fees and the Student Health Plan ($3,049, waivable) excluded. Same tuition for all majors. Not cohort-locked. Four academic years of tuition; co-op periods (many students take 5 years) are not charged tuition. 2024-25 rates not found (prior-year page not published at the usual address). College of Engineering. Retried 2026-10-13: the tuition and fees page shows only 2025-26 and 2026-27; the catalogue archive (catalog.northeastern.edu/archive/2024-2025/...) is blocked to automated reading; Northeastern's 2024-25 Common Data Set labels US$67,990 as 2024-2025 costs although Student Financial Services lists that as the 2025-26 rate, so it was not used; 2024-25 remains unfilled. 2024 row (2026-10-13, unofficial): The Huntington News (3 Oct 2024) states the 2024-25 bill includes '$64,990 in tuition' and '$1,172 in fees' for two semesters. This supports Student Financial Services (US$67,990 is the 2025-26 rate) over the 2024-25 Common Data Set's label, so the CDS/SFS conflict is resolved in favour of SFS. The one-time International Student Fee for 2024-25 was not found, so the row omits one-off fees.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering, MSME (Boston)
programmes.feeBasis: Northeastern Engineering's 2026-27 rate of US$1,977 per credit times 16 credits a year (the 32-credit MS over two years), plus graduate fees.
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for an international full-time master's student at Northeastern (charged per credit, about 16 credits a year), plus campus fees and a one-time international fee. Health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: College of Engineering rate $1,977 per credit hour (2026-27); $1,929 (2025-26). Graduate tuition is charged per credit hour. The programme needs 32 semester hours (catalog), taken here as 16 a year over 2 years, so annual = 16 x rate. Other fees 2026-27 = full-time master's Comprehensive Fee $200 per term (maximum $400 a year) + Health and Counseling Fee $225 a year; one-off = International Student Fee $450. Student health plan ($3,049, waivable) excluded. 2025-26 history row carries tuition only (the 2025-26 fee rows were itemised differently; current fees used). 2024-25 rates not found. Not cohort-locked. Retried 2026-10-13: the tuition and fees page shows only 2025-26 and 2026-27; the catalogue archive (catalog.northeastern.edu/archive/2024-2025/...) is blocked to automated reading; Northeastern's 2024-25 Common Data Set labels US$67,990 as 2024-2025 costs although Student Financial Services lists that as the 2025-26 rate, so it was not used; 2024-25 remains unfilled. Retried 2026-10-13 (unofficial sources): sac.northeastern.edu lists 2024-25 per-credit rates, but at rates far below the Boston rate (e.g. US$1,618 vs US$1,922 for the 2026-27 MSCS), so they are not the Boston programme, so it was not used. Retried 2026-10-13 (round 3): older Student Financial Services tuition posts (studentfinance.northeastern.edu/?p=3831, 5156, 5354) cover only 2019-20 to 2021-22, and the College of Engineering's graduate tuition page lists no rates, so 2024-25 remains unfilled. Retried 2026-10-13 (round 4): the graduate programme page and catalogue show 2026-27 rates only and the tuition page links no earlier rate tables, so 2024-25 remains unfilled. Round 5 (2026-10-13): the 2024-2025 Graduate Catalog archive is now readable with curl; its Tuition and Fees page (https://catalog.northeastern.edu/archive/2024-2025/graduate/expenses/tuition-fees/) gives College of Engineering 'All graduate programs, excepting specific programs listed below' $1,864 per credit hour (this programme is not an exception), so 2024 annual = 16 x $1,864 = $29,824. 2024-25 graduate fees on the same page: Student Center Fee $72 + Student Recreation Fee $62 + Student Activities Fee $17 per term full time (Boston) x 2 + Health and Counseling Fee $225 = $527 a year; International Student Fee $375 one-off; optional health plan $2,499 excluded. 2024 row added. The 2025-2026 archive confirms $1,929 per credit hour for 2025-26.

programmes.name: Accounting, MSA (Boston)
programmes.feeBasis: Northeastern's 2026-27 catalog rate for the MS in Accounting (US$2,482 per credit) times its 30 credits, for the one-year Boston programme. Campus fees and a one-time international fee are added separately.
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for an international full-time student on Northeastern's one-year MS in Accounting (30 credits, charged per credit), plus campus fees and a one-time international fee. Health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: International tier (all graduate students pay the same rate), Boston campus, 30 semester hours (catalog: 30 total semester hours, seven-month programme for students with an accounting undergraduate major), so annual = 30 x per-credit rate and durationYears 1. 2026-27 Academic Catalog tuition page lists 'MSA Accounting' at US$2,482 per credit hour (a programme-specific rate; the Student Financial Services page still shows the general D'Amore-McKim rate of $1,931 and does not list MSA, so the catalog was used) = $74,460. Fees 2026-27: full-time Comprehensive Fee $200 per term x2 + Health and Counseling Fee $225 = $625; one-off International Student Fee $450; MSA has no programme fee. History: MSA is not listed separately in the 2025-26 or 2024-25 catalog tables, so it is charged the general D'Amore-McKim graduate rate: 2025-26 $1,884 x 30 = $56,520 (catalog archive 2025-2026, fees Student Center $85 + Recreation $75 + Activities $19 per term x2 + Health and Counseling $225 = $583, International fee $450); 2024-25 $1,816 x 30 = $54,480 (catalog archive 2024-2025, fees $72+$62+$17 per term x2 + $225 = $527, International fee $375). Student health plan (waivable) excluded. Not cohort-locked.
